title: ClassDataset
description: Onboarding responses for one class section. Inferred from class_dataset.csv (23 records, submitted 2026-09-11T01:47:37Z through 2026-09-12T18:22:33Z). Multi-value CSV cells are semicolon-separated; this schema describes the parsed record.

netid.description: Respondent identifier. Unique in this export, but not a single NYU identifier kind: 19 NetIDs, 2 N-numbers, and 2 @nyu.edu addresses. Case is preserved (one NetID is mixed case).

name.description: Full name as entered on the form.

school_year.description: Class standing. Closed set from the form.

intro_programming.description: Prior intro programming experience. took_it = completed the course, equivalent = placed out or covered the material elsewhere, neither = no prior course.

tools.description: Tools the student listed. CSV cell is joined with '; ' and order is not canonical. Observed vocabulary is closed in this export.

availability.description: Times the student can meet. CSV cell is joined with '; '. Six slots, matching a weekday/weekend by morning/afternoon/evening grid.

working_style.description: Free-text collaboration preference. The export contains one Excel error sentinel (#NAME?) which this schema rejects.

interests.description: Free text. May be a comma list, a prose paragraph, or a newline-separated list inside a quoted CSV field. Trim leading and trailing whitespace; one row is truncated mid-word.

submitted_at.description: Form submission time. CSV values are ISO-8601 with a numeric offset and are 25 characters (all +00:00 in this export).

likert.description: Self-rating from 1 (low) to 5 (high). Stored in the CSV as a single digit character.
